gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with a new probable diagnosis of glioblastoma based on MRI imaging.

candidate_evidence.quote: The evaluation of PET imaging using PET ligand \[18F\]JNJ-64413739 or a \[18F\] labeled equivalent in vivo in patients.
single arm: for diagnostic (interventions: Diagnostic Test: PET imaging)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: prior to initiation of specific tumor therapy and prior to any surgery (including biopsy)

role_evidence.quote: The evaluation of PET imaging using PET ligand \[18F\]JNJ-64413739 or a \[18F\] labeled equivalent in vivo in patients.

agents.drug_class_hint: 18F-labelled P2X7 receptor PET tracer (diagnostic imaging of proinflammatory microglia)

coder_notes: Phase NA (excluded at S3 by script). Diagnostic PET imaging study only; the tracer [18F]JNJ-64413739 is a diagnostic agent, no therapeutic agent. P2X7 receptor PET uptake is an imaging-only marker, not a tumour molecular biomarker, so not recorded. Arm label taken as 'single arm'. Quotes in the record contain escaped brackets (\[18F\]) copied as written.
